R1Z.PV_ROWS10_Entropy.consumed_signal {W : Type} (length : W → Nat) (trace : W → List Control) (nativeSignal : W → Bool)
  (sourceBinding : ∀ (w : W), nativeSignal w = signal (trace w) (length w))
  (publicControl : ∀ (a b : W), trace a = trace b) (publicLength : ∀ (a b : W), length a = length b) (a b : W) :

R1Z.PV_ROWS10_WorkRanges.intermediate_bounds (n k limit : Nat) (hn : n ≤ limit) (hk : k < 16) :
  n / 16 * k ≤ limit ∧
    PV_ROWS10_WorkRanges.start n k ≤ limit ∧
      PV_ROWS10_WorkRanges.start n k + n / 16 ≤ limit ∧ PV_ROWS10_WorkRanges.stop n k ≤ limit
